title: 2022 CODATA: molar volume of ideal gas (273.15 K, 101.325 kPa) is 22.413 969 54... × 10^−3
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks molar volume of ideal gas (273.15 K, 101.325 kPa) as exact: 22.413 969 54...
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks molar volume of ideal gas (273.15 K, 101.325 kPa) as exact: 22.413 969 54... × 10^−3 m^3 mol^-1. The ellipsis is in the file. No further digits are added here. This is the ideal-gas molar volume at 273.15 K and the standard-atmosphere pressure of 101.325 kPa, marked exact. It is the listing's form of the familiar 22.4 litre value, not a measurement of a real gas.
